correctness.rationale: Inspected all seven Git source blobs, proof and enumeration script. Zero vertices cannot be adjacent and cannot be path endpoints. For an eligible zero set of size k, auxiliary inequality edges join its two positive neighbors; except full alternating even cycles this is a forest with k edges, giving 2^(n-2k) proper positive two-colorings. Independent-set numbers are binom(n-k-1,k) for paths, n/(n-k)binom(n-k,k) for cycles. At n=2m alternating zeros produce a positive m-cycle; it has exactly two 2-colorings iff m even, across two zero sets, explaining special term. Characteristic polynomial of transfer T=[[2z,z],[1,0]] and path recurrence yield displayed generating functions; extremal k gives minimum multiplicities. Independent direct enumeration of every ternary labeling for paths 1..8 and cycles 3..8 reproduced all coefficients. Infinite claim follows combinatorial classification, not finite checks.
